definitions.explanation: A line that extends in both directions without curving.

examples.japanese: ⟦{定規|じょうぎ}→定規：04280_jougi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{直線|ちょくせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}く→引く：01978_hiku⟧。
examples.english: Draw a straight line with a ruler.

examples.japanese: ⟦{二|ふた}つ→二つ：02953_futatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{点|てん}→点：01553_ten⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{結|むす}ぶ→結ぶ：02308_musubu⟧{直線|ちょくせん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{一|ひと}つ→一つ：02948_hitotsu⟧⟦しか→しか：09959_shika⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: There is only one straight line connecting two points.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{直線|ちょくせん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧10⟦キロ→キロ：01350_kiro⟧⟦{続|つづ}く→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
examples.english: This road continues straight for 10 kilometers.

notes:
{直線|ちょくせん} means a straight line, used in both mathematical and everyday contexts. The kanji combine ⟦{直|ちょく}→直：noentry⟧ (straight) + ⟦{線|せん}→線：noentry⟧ (line).

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {直線|ちょくせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}く→引く：01978_hiku⟧: to draw a straight line
- {直線|ちょくせん}⟦{距離|きょり}→距離：05331_kyori⟧: straight-line distance (as the crow flies)
- {直線|ちょくせん}⟦コース→コース：10864_koosu⟧: straight course/stretch
- {直線|ちょくせん}⟦{道路|どうろ}→道路：01481_douro⟧: straight road

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {直線|ちょくせん}: straight line
- ⟦{曲線|きょくせん}→曲線：05441_kyokusen⟧: curved line
- ⟦{線分|せんぶん}→線分：26330_senbun⟧: line segment (finite length)
- ⟦{半直線|はんちょくせん}→半直線：noentry⟧: ray (one endpoint)

USAGE:
Also used figuratively: ⟦ゴール→ゴール：03845_gooru⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧{直線|ちょくせん} (a straight shot to the goal / the home stretch).
